informacion.importancePriorityBodyPrefix: Instantly identify which risks need immediate attention. The colors tell you everything:
informacion.importanceDecisionBody: No more decisions in the dark. The map shows you exactly where to invest your time and resources for the greatest impact on risk reduction.
informacion.importanceCommunicationBody: Explain complex risks to any audience. A visual map is universal: executives, technical teams, and stakeholders instantly understand the situation.
informacion.importanceResourceBody: Maximize your budget by allocating resources where they really matter. Avoid wasting money on minor risks when there are bigger problems.
informacion.importanceComplianceBody: Show auditors and regulators that you have a structured risk management process. It's your evidence that you're being proactive.
informacion.importanceCompetitiveBody: Companies that manage risk well survive crises better. It's your insurance for business survival in turbulent times.
informacion.impactStatsTitle: 📊 The Real Impact of the Heat Map:
informacion.stat1Text: of companies using heat maps make better decisions
informacion.usageTitle: 🚀 How to Use the Heat Map?
informacion.usageStep1Body: First you need to have risks identified and categorized. Use the Identification tab.
informacion.usageStep2Body: Assign probability and impact values to each risk using the established criteria.
informacion.usageStep3Body: The map is generated automatically, showing each risk in its corresponding position.
informacion.usageStep4Body: Focus on red risks first, then yellow ones, and keep an eye on green ones.
informacion.heatmapCtaTitle: 🎯 Ready to Create Your Heat Map?
informacion.heatmapCtaBody: Now that you understand the importance and workings of the Heat Map, it's time to put it into practice.
informacion.gestionHeaderDescription: Document recommendations, dates, and progress tracking.
informacion.gestionWhyBodyBold: bridge between risk identification and action
informacion.gestionWhyBodySuffix: Without clear, specific recommendations, identified risks remain as simple observations with no follow-up or resolution.
informacion.benefit1Body: Turn identified problems into specific, measurable solutions
informacion.benefit2Body: Each implemented recommendation strengthens your organization
informacion.benefit3Body: Prevent problems before they become crises
informacion.benefit4Body: It's cheaper to prevent than to fix afterward

informacion.recProcess2Body: Record the recommendation with clear dates and owners
informacion.recProcess3Body: Execute the recommendation with detailed follow-up
informacion.recProcess4Body: Evaluate the impact and document the results
informacion.gestionCta1Body: Go to the "Risk Management" section to start recording and tracking your recommendations.

table.title: Values and rating table

charts.interpretTitle: How should these indicators be interpreted?
charts.standardPerformanceDescription: % obtained over each standard's weight (0312 calculation)
charts.interpretOfficial: Official Compliance corresponds to the rating established by Resolution 0312 of 2019 and automatically considers standards that do not apply to the company according to its size and risk level.
